newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's June industrial growth up 7.6 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru's June industrial growth up 7.6 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru's industrial sector in June expanded 7.6 percent year over year, compared with 2.2 percent growth for the same month of 1996, Industry Ministry officials said Monday.
Overall the economy is expected to show year-over-year growth of more than seven percent in June 1997, according to analysts. That would compare 5.1 percent growth in the same month last year.
The June 1997 growth figure -- to be published later this week -- is expected to be led by the construction sector, analysts said.
The economy's cumulative growth in the first five months of 1997 was 7.1 percent, compared with a 1.1 percent in the same period in 1996.
The government forecasts five percent growth in 1997.
